summary: Iteration 4 — Verification of Code Quality Report fix batch (mikrotik-script defensive init, secrets.SystemRandom in mikrotik-test / vpn/test, and multiple frontend useCallback / logging refactors). Backend: all 13 pytest tests pass (5 new tests added for mikrotik-script × 3 protocols, mikrotik-test, vpn/test). Frontend: login → /panel, /clientes, /usuarios (new-user), /mikrotik wizard + Probar diagnostic dialog all OK. Two regressions and one pre-existing gap uncovered: (1) Payments.jsx used useCallback WITHOUT importing it → PAGEERROR that broke /pagos entirely and also fired on any page that mounted the header (I applied the trivial one-line import fix and reverified); (2) ServerInfoPanel is defined and updated but NEVER imported/rendered on the Mikrotik page (grep shows zero import sites) — the review request explicitly expects copy-public_ip etc. buttons visible on /mikrotik, currently absent; (3) 'Editar usuario' dialog does not pre-fill the existing user's name/phone/role fields (dialog opens with empty inputs) — likely a FormDialog initial-state issue that is orthogonal to the useCallback refactor but still fails the review requirement 'edit dialog with pre-filled name'.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `useCallback` import — page threw runtime 'useCallback is not defined' and /pagos rendered blank; also polluted /panel with the same error via header widgets. Fixed by testing agent (added useCallback to the react import).

ServerInfoPanel component is not imported/rendered anywhere. `grep -rn ServerInfoPanel /app/frontend/src` shows only the component definition. Consequently there are 0 [data-testid^='copy-'] buttons on /mikrotik and no 'Datos del servidor' section, contradicting review requirement 'shows the ServerInfoPanel with copy buttons (copy-public_ip etc.)'.

Opening edit dialog via [data-testid^='edit-user-'] shows empty Nombre / Teléfono inputs and role forced to 'Técnico' even when editing the owner 'Benja'. `initial={editing || ...}` prop is passed but FormDialog does not seem to reset its internal form state when `initial` changes across openings.

issues: Repeated React console warning 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' emitted by PendingSection — key must be passed directly, not spread. Non-blocking but noisy.
(Pre-existing from iteration 3) Stadia tiles 401 — unrelated to this batch.

action_items: Import and render <ServerInfoPanel /> on /app/frontend/src/pages/Mikrotik.jsx (e.g. above or below the table) so the copy-* testids exist as the review request expects.
Fix FormDialog / Users edit flow so opening the edit dialog pre-fills name, phone, role from the selected user (likely need to reset internal state when `initial`/`open` changes).
Fix PendingSection JSX to pass `key` directly instead of spreading it inside props (React 19+ warning).
Confirm the useCallback-import fix I applied to Payments.jsx is acceptable; consider a lint rule (eslint react-hooks + no-undef) to catch these missing imports going forward.
critical_code_review_comments: The Code Quality batch added `const load = useCallback(...)` in Payments.jsx without adding useCallback to the React import — this is a hard runtime error, not a warning. A lint pass or `yarn build` would have caught it before landing.
ServerInfoPanel refactor (steps use string key) is a dead-code change until the panel is actually mounted somewhere. Verify it's wired into the Mikrotik page (or Config) before shipping.
server.py mikrotik_script defensive init of filename/script/steps is correct — all three protocols return non-empty script + steps + protocol keys (verified via parametrized pytest).
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Payments.jsx (added useCallback to React import to unblock /pagos)
/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestMikrotikAndVpnEndpoints class covering the 3 endpoints under review)

success_rate.frontend: 75% (7/10 review points; ServerInfoPanel missing, edit-user prefill broken, Payments regression required test-agent hotfix)

seed_data_creation: None new. Reused existing devices (jupiter2, MK-Prueba-Wizard, MK-Central, MK1) and clients. Iteration 3 TEST_NAP_Z NAP still present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for mikrotik-script (all 3 protocols), mikrotik-test (30 samples, ≥7 checks, int rx/tx), and vpn/{id}/test are fully verified via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py TestMikrotikAndVpnEndpoints. On the frontend, after Payments.jsx useCallback import was added, the /pagos page, tabs (3 present), payments-search filter, and ?client=<id> preselect dialog all work. Still open: (a) ServerInfoPanel not mounted on /mikrotik — copy-* testids absent, (b) Editar usuario dialog doesn't pre-fill fields, (c) PendingSection key-spread warning. Header pending-trigger and inbox-trigger popovers open cleanly. Panel de control shows Ingresos/Pagos labels and 33 SVGs (charts + icons).
rca_of_the_issue: Payments.jsx: refactor to `const load = useCallback(async () => {...}, [])` was added but the top-level `import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'` was not updated. As soon as Payments.jsx module executed (Payments page or any page that imports it via router/lazy) `useCallback` was undefined, producing PAGEERROR 'useCallback is not defined' and crashing the component render. Users.jsx correctly added useCallback to its import; Payments.jsx did not. One-line fix: add useCallback to the React import.
